description: CSV data profile + CREATE TABLE — Profile a CSV and generate a schema. csv= inline text (newline-separated rows) or url= link to a CSV file (first 1 MB). Auto-detects delimiter (comma, tab, semicolon, pipe) and header row. Per column: inferred type (integer, decimal, boolean, date, datetime, email, url, uuid, string, numeric codes with leading zeros), nulls, distinct, uniqueness, min/max length, numeric stats (mean, median, sd, quartiles, IQR outliers), date range, top values and flags (formatted numbers, mixed types, whitespace, constant columns). Dataset: duplicate rows, ragged rows, candidate keys, completeness, quality score GOOD/FAIR/POOR, and a CREATE TABLE statement (dialect=postgres|mysql|sqlite|bigquery|snowflake, table=name). Optional delimiter=, header=false. Profiles up to 20,000 cells. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_csv_profile
